minutes.headline: Committee agreed it is too early for a November warrant article and kept shaping a square-footage-and-cost RFP package.
minutes.summary: The Municipal Building Design Committee approved prior minutes and agreed it cannot request funding at the November town meeting because no dollar figure exists yet. Most of the meeting was brainstorming what the RFP package should cover: meeting rooms, accessibility, parking, storage, annex options, and the aim of narrowing square footage and cost. The senior-housing grant item was dropped, and the next meeting was set for the 26th.

budget_items.topic: Funding request for November town warrant
budget_items.what_was_said: Members said no dollar figure can be put on a warrant article yet, so it is too early.

The chair cited a prior study estimating the cost of replacing the town hall basement slab; one member called it a no-brainer for the capital plan, while another said piecemeal work on the old building is unwise.
Members said the RFP work should yield a cost range the voters can be asked to approve, and noted a prior discussion of a very large project.
The chair prefers asking firms to quote on an estimated number of hours rather than naming a dollar figure, since past fixed figures drew bids at exactly that amount.

decisions.decision: No article will be submitted for the November town meeting; the chair will tell the select board it is premature.
Chair will request the monthly calendar of meetings from the town clerk's office to gauge simultaneous meeting-room needs.
Chair will seek a sample architectural RFP from Greg or others and work with the select board; a sample will be circulated.
The MHP grant / senior housing item is removed from the agenda, since the select board discussion indicated it is outside the committee's charge.
Broader community-center needs and any TC Pacios discussion are deferred until after the fall town meeting.
The RFP package will aim at square footage and a cost range, not building design.
Next meeting set for the 26th, with Zoom available and in person at the Ritter building.

what_happened.line: The committee agreed it is too early to put a funding article on the November town meeting warrant, because no dollar figure exists yet.
The chair will tell the select board that an article would be premature.
The committee settled on an RFP package aimed at square footage and a cost range, not building design.
The senior-housing grant item was removed from the agenda as outside the committee's charge; broader community-center needs wait until after the fall town meeting.
The chair will ask the town clerk for the monthly meeting calendar and seek a sample architectural RFP; the next meeting was set for the 26th.

why_it_matters: No municipal building funding question will be on the November ballot or town meeting floor, so voters will not be asked to approve a dollar figure until the RFP work produces a cost range.

The RFP is meant to give voters a square-footage and cost range to decide on later, so what it covers (meeting rooms, accessibility, parking, annex options) will shape the size of any future town office request.
watch_next: Next committee meeting on the 26th, on Zoom and in person at the Ritter building.
The sample architectural RFP the chair is to circulate, and the town clerk's meeting calendar.
